alive.last_commit_message:
fix(models): avoid panic on unclosed JSON fences with leading text (#713)

Fix a panic in GetJsonString when a model response has leading text followed by a JSON opening fence without a closing fence (e.g. "prefix ```json\n[]"), which produced slice bounds out of range [14:7]. The AI infrastructure scan initialization path calls this helper before json.Unmarshal, so such a response panicked the scan instead of falling back.

The fix requires the closing fence index to be at or after the content start (startIndex+7) before slicing; incomplete fences now return the original input, preserving the existing fallback contract.

This fully resolves issue #712 (the panic and unchanged return contract are covered at the helper boundary).

Local verification:
- go build ./... clean.
- go vet ./common/utils/models/ clean.
- go test ./common/utils/models/ -count=1 PASS (new table-driven TestGetJsonString covers unclosed/complete/empty/missing-opening/missing-closing fences, with and without surrounding text).
- CI green (GITHUB_OPENSOURCE_SCAN_PIPELINE + Build and test Go packages success).

Closes #712

Co-authored-by: helo060228 <helo060228@users.noreply.github.com>
